text: dsh-composer-fix 是一款面向 DSH Web 的界面布局修复插件。它通过客户端 bundle 调整会话区域和输入栏的布局，并把消息列表的滚动职责从外层容器交还给消息列表，使滚动条停留在消息区域，避免历史消息滚到输入栏和底部状态栏下方。插件还让输入栏保持在滚动区下方，并在窗口或侧栏布局变化后重新对齐 Git 分支 chip 与输入卡片。适合希望改善 DSH Web 会话阅读和输入体验的用户。源码显示它通过 DOM 属性和样式实现这些调整，不要求额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-composer-fix improves DSH Web layout. It lets the message list scroll independently, keeping history above the composer and status bar. It realigns the Git branch chip after window or sidebar resizing. The client uses DOM attributes and styles; no API key or external service is required.
DSH Web 往上翻聊天记录时，内容总会钻到输入框下面，怎么让滚动区域停在输入栏上方？
How can I keep the branch chip aligned with the message composer when I resize the DSH window or move the sidebar?
dsh-composer-fix 的功能「消息区与输入栏分离」：让消息列表自行滚动，并将输入栏固定在滚动区域下方。插件启动后自动修正现有及重建的会话滚动容器。
dsh-composer-fix 的功能「分支标记对齐」：自动测量 Git 分支 chip 与输入卡片的边缘，并在窗口、侧栏或面板布局尺寸变化后重新对齐。
dsh-composer-fix 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 87 天；提交数 4；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-composer-fix README · dsh-composer-fix：> 简体中文: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web GUI layout fix: moves the composer (input bar + bottom status bar) **out of the scroll region**.

dsh-composer-fix README · What it does：In the default DSH layout the composer sticks (`position: sticky`) to the bottom of the message scroll container, so the scrollbar spans the whole container — **including the input bar and the bottom status bar**. When you scroll up through history, message content slides underneath the input/status bar; under translucent skins like harbor it even shows through.

dsh-composer-fix README · What it does：This plugin moves the scrolling responsibility from the container down to the **message list itself** (attribute-only operations — no DOM node moves, no hash-class dependencies):

dsh-composer-fix README · How it works (one sentence)：Removes the `data-conversation-scroll` attribute from the scroll container (core uses it to lift scrolling and force the list to `overflow: visible`), so the message list resumes its own scrolling; `scrollerOf()` / wheel logic falls back to the list itself via `closest(...) ?? from`.

dsh-composer-fix README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/AnakinCao/dsh-composer-fix.git
```

The plugin is a client bundle; after installing, refresh the page (or restart `dsh web`) to load it.

dsh-composer-fix README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-composer-fix
```
